To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
FibroMeter3 G has the best performance in detailed fibrosis staging and Fibrotest has the best performance for significant fibrosis staging.

the accuracy of FibroMeter2 and FibroMeter4 in fibrosis classification is higher than the accuracy of Fibrosis4 and Fibroscan and that the accuracy of detailed classification is lower than that of binary classification.

the accuracy of detailed classification of fibrosis degree by blood tests is higher than that by a local pathologists' reading but lower than that by Fibroscan and that FibroMeter is the best-performing test.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the accuracy of fibrosis classifications by liver biopsy, blood tests and Fibrosan in hepatitis C patients.
the development of a new non-invasive test, FibroMeter, for the evaluation of liver fibrosis in patients with chronic hepatitis C.
the evaluation of the accuracy of detailed liver fibrosis classifications available from non-invasive tests (blood tests, Fibroscan) and liver biopsy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the accuracy of FibroMeter3 in fibrosis classification is significantly better than those of other available non-invasive tests, and even better than that of liver biopsy read by local pathologists.
the best-performing non-invasive tests for fibrosis degree classification are blood tests, but their classification precision is lower than that of liver biopsy.
the best-performing non-invasive tests outperform liver biopsy in clinical practice, but the classification accuracy is apparently less than that of significant or severe fibrosis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

FibroMeter3 is the most accurate blood test for fibrosis staging, but FibroMeter2 is the most accurate test for fibrosis classification, and Fibroscan is the most accurate for binary fibrosis diagnoses.
FibroMeter3 is the best-performing non-invasive test in hepatitis C, especially for detailed fibrosis classification.
the best-performing non-invasive test is the one that provides the best classification precision.
The main takeaway from our work is that
FibroMeter2/3G are the best-performing tests for detailed fibrosis classification, and that FibroMeter3 is the most accurate test for significant fibrosis classification.
FibroMeter3 is the best-performing non-invasive test available for the assessment of fibrosis degree in hepatitis C.
the accuracy of the best-perfoming blood test outperformed liver biopsy read by local pathologist.
